title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
source: Recording Info: SBD > Master Reels > Dat (16-bit/44.1k) > upsampled to 24-bit/96k; Mastering Info: WAV > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; Master Reel Transferred by Rob Eaton; All Mastering By Charlie Miller; the original version of this source had a 2 second dropout in thrack 16 (Playing In The Band)

ai_review.summary: Mr. Miller's pristine soundboard captures a soaring first set with legendary solo passages, though some listeners note occasional lyrical mumbling.
ai_review.review: The recording benefits from Mr. Miller’s high‑fidelity soundboard source, delivering crystal‑clear instrument separation and no reported dropouts. Musically the show is hailed as one of the best first sets of ’73, highlighted by soaring solos on “He’s Gone,” “They Love Each Other,” “Box of Rain” and a wild “Playing in the Band,” while a few fans find the vocal delivery on “Wave That Flag” uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (≈4.5) and excellent soundboard recording (≈5), tempered by a single very negative review that lowers the overall average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised as a ‘godsend’ from Mr. Miller; clear, balanced mix with no major issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistent momentum and superb sequencing; first set flows beautifully with inspired song order.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for soaring solo passages and an enthusiastic vocal exclamation ('Whoo! Walk on waves!').
